context: Coinbase announced RLUSD distribution across XRPL, Base and Ethereum on 2026-10-28. The XRPL dashboard displayed a large XRPL RLUSD supply decline, while XRP Insights refreshed exchange-wallet change figures.
decisions: Maintain RLUSD supply as a chain-specific stablecoin feature family; do not combine XRPL, Ethereum and Base unless all chain supplies and bridge/mint/burn paths are covered at aligned cutoffs.
Do not interpret the XRPL RLUSD decrease as XRP buying, XRP selling, or a native XRP capital flow.
Do not interpret the 22.48B XRP attributed exchange-wallet total as tradable float; it includes cold custody, customer omnibus balances and 487.2M XRP in wrapped/operational reserves.

Preserve the 2026-10-31 17:57 source capture and the current page capture separately. The current page display supersedes the prior values for the latest observation, but the reason for the revision is unknown.

Keep the current XRP Insights same-wallet values provider-specific: total -133.0M over 7 days and -12.3M over 30 days; Binance +17.6M/+30.3M; Coinbase +17.7M/+18.4M; Upbit -0.747M/+34.6M; SBI VC Trade -0.899M/-10.5M.
Keep the prior CryptoQuant Binance reserve series separate from the broad XRP Insights attributed-wallet series; no cross-provider averaging or causal stitching.
required_followup: Obtain Base RLUSD supply and align Ethereum, XRPL and Base snapshots at the same cutoff.
Acquire transaction-level XRPL RLUSD issuer and bridge transfer IDs for the 2026-10-30/31 decrease.
Verify whether the XRPL dashboard's signed daily snapshot signature can be independently recomputed.
Archive both XRP Insights captures and obtain the provider's raw daily per-exchange series to explain the same-day 30-day revision.
Crosswalk the five Binance incident source wallets against the 153-wallet XRP Insights Binance set and the narrower CryptoQuant series.
